tests.name: cbor_basic_object_serialization
tests.intent: Probes CBOR object serialization with string keys, exercising direct string helper paths instead of temporary basic_json objects.

tests.name: msgpack_basic_object_serialization
tests.intent: Probes MessagePack object serialization with string keys to exercise direct write_msgpack_string helper logic.

tests.name: cbor_iterative_nested_object_keys
tests.intent: Probes iterative CBOR serialization for deeply nested objects to exercise write_cbor_iterative and key handling past recursion limits.

tests.name: msgpack_iterative_nested_object_keys
tests.intent: Probes iterative MessagePack serialization on deeply nested objects to exercise write_msgpack_iterative.

tests.name: cbor_custom_key_type_implicit_convertible
tests.intent: Verify compilation and execution with a custom object key type implicitly convertible to string_t when serializing to CBOR.

tests.name: msgpack_custom_key_type_implicit_convertible
tests.intent: Verify compilation and execution with a custom object key type implicitly convertible to string_t when serializing to MessagePack.

tests.name: cbor_strict_utf8_error_handling
tests.intent: Probes CBOR key serialization under strict error handler when invalid UTF-8 string keys are encountered.

tests.name: msgpack_strict_utf8_error_handling
tests.intent: Probes MessagePack key serialization under strict error handler with invalid UTF-8 keys.

tests.name: cbor_replace_utf8_error_handling
tests.intent: Probes CBOR key serialization with replace error handler for invalid UTF-8 sequences in keys.

tests.name: msgpack_replace_utf8_error_handling
tests.intent: Probes MessagePack key serialization with replace error handler for invalid UTF-8 sequences in keys.

tests.name: cbor_ignore_utf8_error_handling
tests.intent: Probes CBOR key serialization with ignore error handler for invalid UTF-8 characters.

tests.name: msgpack_ignore_utf8_error_handling
tests.intent: Probes MessagePack key serialization with ignore error handler for invalid UTF-8 characters.

tests.name: cbor_empty_object_keys
tests.intent: Probes CBOR serialization of an object with an empty string key.

tests.name: msgpack_empty_object_keys
tests.intent: Probes MessagePack serialization of an object containing an empty string key.

tests.name: cbor_long_object_keys
tests.intent: Probes CBOR object serialization with keys longer than short-string optimization (SSO) length threshold.

tests.name: msgpack_long_object_keys
tests.intent: Probes MessagePack object serialization with long keys exceeding fixstr boundaries.

tests.name: cbor_very_long_msgpack_str32_keys
tests.intent: Probes MessagePack object serialization with keys requiring str32 lengths (greater than 65535 bytes).

tests.name: cbor_multiple_keys_mixed_lengths
tests.intent: Probes CBOR serialization with multiple keys of varying lengths (SSO and non-SSO) within a single object.

tests.name: msgpack_multiple_keys_mixed_lengths
tests.intent: Probes MessagePack serialization with multiple keys of mixed lengths in a single object structure.

tests.name: cbor_ordered_json_object_keys
tests.intent: Probes CBOR serialization using nlohmann::ordered_json to verify compatibility with alternative map container types for keys.

tests.name: test_static_assert_custom_key_type
tests.intent: Trigger the static_assert check on object_t::key_type being convertible to string_t during CBOR and MessagePack serialization by instantiating basic_json with a custom key type.

tests.name: test_iterative_cbor_nested_keys
tests.intent: Trigger write_cbor_string via iterative CBOR writing (write_cbor_iterative) by nesting objects beyond the recursion depth limit.

tests.name: test_iterative_msgpack_nested_keys
tests.intent: Trigger write_msgpack_string via iterative MessagePack writing (write_msgpack_iterative) by nesting objects beyond recursion depth limit.

tests.name: test_msgpack_str16_key
tests.intent: Trigger MessagePack str16 output branch for object keys whose length falls between 32 and 65535 bytes.

tests.name: test_msgpack_str32_key
tests.intent: Trigger MessagePack str32 output branch for object keys whose length exceeds 65535 bytes.

tests.name: test_static_assert_custom_key_type_fixed
tests.intent: Trigger the static_assert check on object_t::key_type being convertible to string_t during CBOR and MessagePack serialization by instantiating basic_json with a custom key type.

tests.name: test_static_assert_custom_key_type_fixed_fixed
tests.intent: Trigger the static_assert check on object_t::key_type being convertible to string_t during CBOR and MessagePack serialization by instantiating basic_json with a custom key type.
